Akshay Jatia: 
Good evening, everyone, and thank you for joining us. This was a significant quarter 
for us. October marks 30 years of McDonald's West and South in India. And next 
week, we'll be opening our 500th restaurant. These milestones are a reminder of how 
far we've come, but more importantly, they reinforce our confidence in the 
opportunity the market presents ahead.  
This quarter, we delivered our strongest performance in 13 quarters with double-digit 
growth in both guest count and same-store sales. Revenue grew 16%, reflecting 
broad-based strength across markets and channels. What is particularly encouraging 
is that this growth was driven by more customers choosing McDonald's more often. 

 
 
Page 3 of 19 
 
At the heart of this performance is a strategy that remains simple and consistent. We 
are focused on strengthening our value leadership, staying relevant to customers and 
delivering a great restaurant experience every time they visit us. Our everyday value 
platform continues to resonate strongly, helping drive guest growth and frequency.  
Through our Let's Family at McDonald's platform, we continue to strengthen the 
emotional and cultural relevance of the brand, reinforcing McDonalds' place in the 
lives of consumers across generations. The consistency of these results reinforces our 
belief that value, relevance and execution remain the right levers to drive long-term 
growth. 
 
Importantly, we are also growing responsibly. Strong same-store sales growth 
translated into healthy margin expansion with operating EBITDA growing 29% year-
on-year during the quarter. Our focus remains on building a business that can deliver 
sustainable growth while creating long-term value for all stakeholders. We continue 
to see significant opportunities ahead.  
Our restaurant expansion strategy remains disciplined, and we remain focused on 
building presence in the right markets through the right formats while maintaining 
prudent capital allocation. As we celebrate 30 years in India, our focus is firmly on the 
future. The momentum we saw through the quarter has continued into October, 
giving us confidence as we enter the festive season.  
Our priorities remain unchanged: strengthen our value leadership, grow guest counts, 
run great restaurants and expand profitably. With a strong brand, a growing 
restaurant network and significant runway ahead, we remain excited about the next 
phase of growth. Thank you. And with that, let me hand it over to our Managing 
Director, Saurabh Kalra, to take you through the quarter in great detail. 
Saurabh Kalra: 
Thank you, Akshay, and good evening, everyone. Best wishes for the Dussehra and 
the upcoming festive season. Q2 marks expected acceleration in our business 
performance. Revenue grew 16% year-on-year to INR7.47 billion, our strongest top 
line growth in the last 13 quarters, while same-store sales also grew at a double-digit 
10.1%.  
Most encouraging, guest count grew in double digits in each month of this quarter, 
demonstrating the strength of consumer demand and effectiveness of our brand plus 
value strategy. Our Let's Family at McDonald's and Everyday Value platform continue 

 
 
Page 4 of 19 
to be the key driver of consumer traffic, helping us strengthen frequency and drive 
higher restaurant sales.  
Both on-premise and off-premise channels delivered a healthy growth of 17% and 
15%, respectively. These results reinforce our belief that the customers continue to 
respond positively to a combination of brand value, convenience and consistently 
strong restaurant experiences.  
Digital also continued to play an important role in our business. Digital channels 
contributed over 75% of sales during the quarter, increasing by around 60 basis points 
year-on-year. We now have more than 58 million cumulative app downloads and 
approximately 4.2 million monthly active users.  
As we have said before, we view digital not simply as a channel, but as an important 
enabler of convenience, frequency and customer loyalty. The strong top line growth 
also translated into meaningful profit expansion. Operating EBITDA grew 29% year-
on-year with margins expanding by 130 basis points to 13.1%.  
This was achieved despite absorbing over 190 basis points of inflationary pressure 
across commodities, utilities and employee costs. The quarter once again 
demonstrated the strength of our business model. With higher sales flowing through 
to the profitability through operating leverage and disciplined cost management.  
Restaurant operating margin remained healthy at 19.3%, while cash PAT stood at 
INR526 million, representing 7% of the sales. We also continue to expand our 
restaurant network during the quarter, opening 11 new restaurants, taking our total 
footprint to 492 across 80 cities now.  
As we approach our 500th restaurant milestone, our expansion strategy remains 
disciplined and focused on long-term value creation. We continue to see significant 
opportunity across existing and emerging markets and remain on track for our targets 
of 580+ restaurants by March 2028.  
Overall, we are pleased with the progress we have made this quarter. Strong guest 
count, double-digit same-store sales growth, margin expansion and continued 
network development reinforces our confidence in the business. While operating 
environment remains dynamic, our strategy remains unchanged: drive guest count 
growth through value and relevance, obviously, having with us with a strong brand, 
execute consistently and deliver sustainable profitable growth.
